subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The SolarWinds Supply Chain Hack
description: One-minute skill: The SolarWinds Supply Chain Hack.

hook.text: Russian hackers hid malware inside a routine software update. 18,000 organizations installed it.

buildup.text: SolarWinds' Orion tool was used by government agencies and Fortune 500 firms to manage their networks.

discovery.text: The malware sat undetected for months, giving attackers access to the most sensitive US systems.

twist.text: SolarWinds' build server password had been 'solarwinds123.' A basic failure with catastrophic reach.

climax.text: The biggest supply chain hack in history started with a laughably weak password.

quiz.question: How did attackers compromise SolarWinds?
options: Malware was hidden in a routine software update
Physical access to a data center
